description:
Location: Bangalore Company: Alstom Job Summary Could you be the full-time ISR Training Engineer in Bangalore were looking for Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your engineering and training expertise in a new cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and dedicated teammates. You'll play a key role in delivering impactful training solutions that meet our customers needs and support the successful operation and maintenance of our railway systems. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (such as Bid Managers, ISR Project Managers, Service Platform REF LIB Managers), engage with subcontractors for training activities, and ensure the development and delivery of high-quality training materials and manuals. Youll specifically take care of creating and revising operation and maintenance manuals, but also organizing and conducting training sessions for our customers. Responsibilities Identifying customer training requirements and needs during the tender phase Participating in the ILS training offer and preparing draft ILS training management plans for bids Managing interfaces and deliverables with ISR WP managers Preparing, verifying, and delivering training documentation Organizing training sessions, including logistics such as booking trainers, venues, travel, and materials Evaluating customer satisfaction and gathering feedback to improve future training sessions Capitalizing on data and lessons learned to enhance quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) performance Supporting the creation and revision of maintenance manuals (e.g., IPC, Maintenance Manual, Operation Manual) All about you We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: Engineering University Degree 5 years of experience in training within TOs training scope Understanding of railway technical knowledge, particularly in operation and maintainability aspects Experience in a maintenance contract Fluency in English Team leadership abilities Knowledge of key ISR elements applicable to railway equipment (e.g., technical publishing, training) (desirable) Things youll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also: Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines Work with new security standards for rail signalling Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues Contribute to innovative projects Utilise our dynamic and flexible working environment Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning Progress towards leadership roles or other career opportunities within Alstom Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension) You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you! Important to note As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Conduct initial candidate evaluations, technical pre-screening, and competency-based interviews. Coordinate interview processes with hiring managers and technical stakeholders. Manage candidate progression through interview, offer, negotiation, and onboarding stages. Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Support permanent, contract, and project-based hiring initiatives. Develop and maintain talent pools across high-demand technology domains including: Cloud Engineering (AWS, Azure, GCP) DevOps & Platform Engineering Software Engineering Data Engineering & Analytics AI & Machine Learning Cyber Security Enterprise Applications & Digital Transformation Build long-term relationships with active and passive candidates. Support workforce planning and rapid project ramp-ups across multiple client engagements. Stakeholder Management Partner closely with hiring managers, delivery leads, practice managers, and business leaders. Provide market insights and hiring recommendations. Facilitate role briefing sessions and recruitment strategy discussions. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding hiring progress, market challenges, and talent availability. Market Intelligence & Employer Branding Stay current with technology hiring trends across India and global markets. Provide salary benchmarking, talent mapping, and competitor intelligence. Contribute to employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives. Represent Cloud Raptor professionally across candidate and networking engagements. Recruitment Operations Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Track recruitment metrics, pipeline status, and hiring performance. Ensure compliance with internal recruitment processes and hiring standards. Support process improvement initiatives to increase recruitment efficiency and hiring outcomes. Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of technical recruitment experience within consulting, staffing, managed services, or technology environments. Proven experience recruiting across technology disciplines. Strong understanding of modern technology skill sets including Cloud, DevOps, Software Engineering, Data, AI, and Cyber Security. Demonstrated success sourcing passive candidates through direct channels. Experience managing multiple vacancies simultaneously in a high-growth environment. Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills. Strong organisation and attention to detail. Experience using ATS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and modern recruitment tools. 
 Preferred Experience Experience recruiting for Indian, Australian, UK, US, or APAC markets. Experience supporting cloud and digital transformation projects. Contribution to business growth and project delivery success. What We Offer Competitive salary package with performance incentives. Exposure to international clients and global hiring programs. Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding technology consultancy. Collaborative and high-performance work environment. Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
